title: MRR ConceptCharter
description: docs/spec/08_RESEARCH_METHOD_KERNEL.md (status ACCEPTED, 2026-07-21) section 3's object table ('ConceptCharter | versioned local operationalizations of load-bearing terms; a local map, never a global ontology | draft -> accepted -> superseded'). Second of the six task-packets/K1-T01.yaml entities. 'entries' is required non-empty (a charter with zero entries operationalizes nothing, mirroring source-family.schema.json's own member_source_ids non-degeneracy precedent). Each entry carries its own entry_id — required unique within one ConceptCharter revision (enforced at the Pydantic layer by a model_validator; JSON Schema's uniqueItems does not check a single sub-field) — because spec 08 section 3's 'operationalizes' edge description (ConceptCharter entry -> QuestionModel term) points at ONE entry, and MRR-MTH-018's 'versioned charter entries' (referenced by MethodProtocol.sensitivity_variations) needs a stable handle finer-grained than the charter's own baseObject.id. The operationalizes edge itself is explicitly task-packets/K1-T02.yaml's addition — these entries exist as addressable data ahead of that edge.

entries.description: Versioned local operationalizations of load-bearing terms (spec 08 section 3). Required non-empty — a charter with zero entries operationalizes nothing. `uniqueItems` catches a fully-duplicated entry at the schema level; the stronger same-entry_id-different-content case (the more common real mistake) is caught only by the Pydantic model_validator below, since JSON Schema has no per-subfield uniqueness construct.

entry_id.description: Stable handle for this entry, unique within one ConceptCharter revision (enforced by a Pydantic model_validator, not expressible as a plain JSON Schema per-field constraint). Referenced by MethodProtocol.sensitivity_variations (MTH-018) and, in a later task, the operationalizes edge.

term.description: The load-bearing term this entry operationalizes — expected, but not schema-enforced here, to match a string in some QuestionModel.load_bearing_terms list (cross-object matching is service-level, deferred).

definition.description: The operationalization text itself — this local map's actual content.

status.description: Lifecycle status (spec 08 section 3's table: draft -> accepted -> superseded).
